# Antigravity CLI 1.1.15 currentness corpus

Secret-free identity freeze for host Antigravity `1.1.9` and official
GitHub `google-antigravity/antigravity-cli` `1.1.15` before Swallowtail
widens `antigravity-cli.release`.

Official artifacts stayed in `/tmp`. Extracted `--version` reports
`1.1.15`. Selected `--print` flags, exact `--conversation`, and `models`
remain. `--input-format` and Gemini API-key sign-in stay unmapped.
Public git `1.1.14..1.1.15` is changelog-only; the GitHub asset is a new
signed binary.

`1.1.8` stays independently unqualified. No provider prompt. No live
catalogue. No live print run. The host install was not replaced. The
frozen `1.1.14` corpus stays.
